label: OK
description: The request succeeded and the page loaded normally.
statusDescription: We were able to fully scan your site.

label: Moved Permanently
description: The URL has permanently moved to a new address.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: Links and search engines pointing to this URL land on a redirect instead of the final page, which can slow load times, dilute SEO signals, and cause automated scans that don't follow redirects to miss the real content.
recommendation: Point your links at the new address instead of the old one, and make sure the redirect is one you meant to set up.
recommendationTechnical: Update internal links, sitemaps, and external references to point directly at the destination URL. Confirm the redirect is intentional and permanent, not a leftover from an old site migration.

label: Found
description: The URL has temporarily moved to a new address.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: Search engines treat this as a temporary move, so the original URL keeps its indexing weight even though visitors are sent elsewhere. It's easy to leave a 302 in place long after the move became permanent.
recommendation: Decide whether this move is permanent. If it is, ask your web team to make it a permanent redirect. If it's temporary, remove it once you no longer need it.
recommendationTechnical: If the move is permanent, switch to a 301 redirect. If it's genuinely temporary, confirm the destination is correct and remove the redirect once it's no longer needed.

label: Bad Request
description: The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax or formatting.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: The server rejected the request outright, so the page never loads for visitors, search engines, or AI crawlers hitting this URL.
recommendation: Open the address in a browser and see if it works. If it doesn't, ask your web team to look at what's wrong with it.
recommendationTechnical: Check the URL for malformed query parameters or encoding issues, and review server logs for the exact validation error being triggered.

label: Unauthorized
description: The requested resource requires authentication. The client must log in to access it.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: This page is locked behind a login, so it's invisible to the public, search engines, and AI tools — even if it's meant to be publicly available.
recommendation: Decide whether this page is meant to be public. If it is, ask your web team to remove the login requirement. If it isn't, take it out of your sitemap and off your public pages.
recommendationTechnical: If the page should be public, remove the authentication requirement. If it's intentionally private, remove it from your sitemap and any public-facing links.

label: Forbidden
description: The server understood the request but refused to fulfill it. The client does not have permission to access this resource.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: The server actively blocked access, which may indicate misconfigured permissions, a firewall rule, or a bot-blocking tool that's also blocking legitimate crawlers (like ScanGovBot).
recommendation: Something on your site is turning visitors away, and it's catching good bots too. Ask whoever manages your security settings to let good bots through. See ScanGovBot for what to allow.
recommendationTechnical: Review server/firewall rules and any bot-protection service (e.g. a WAF or Cloudflare) to confirm search engines and monitoring tools aren't being blocked unintentionally. Allow the ScanGovBot user-agent, or allowlist 44.236.34.143.

label: Not Found
description: The server could not find the requested page or resource.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: The page no longer exists at this address, creating a broken link for anyone who visits it, including from search results, bookmarks, or other sites linking here.
recommendation: Put the page back, or send this address to wherever the content lives now. Then update any menus or links still pointing here.
recommendationTechnical: Restore the page at this URL, or set up a redirect to its new location or the closest relevant page. Update internal links and the sitemap to remove the dead URL.

label: Request Timeout
description: The server closed the connection because the request took too long to complete.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: The server took too long to respond, so the page failed to load — this can point to performance problems or an overloaded server.
recommendation: Your site is taking too long to answer. Ask your web team to look at why pages are slow.
recommendationTechnical: Investigate server response times and resource usage. If timeouts are frequent, consider caching, scaling server resources, or optimizing slow backend queries.

label: Gone
description: The requested resource has been permanently removed and will not be available again.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: The page was intentionally and permanently removed, so anyone linking to it — including search engines — hits a dead end with no path forward.
recommendation: If this content moved somewhere else, send this address there instead. If it's really gone, remove links to it from your menus and sitemap.
recommendationTechnical: If the content moved rather than disappeared, use a redirect instead of a 410. Otherwise, remove references to this URL from menus, sitemaps, and external links.

label: Too Many Requests
description: The client sent too many requests in a short period and the server is rate-limiting access.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: The server is rate-limiting requests to this URL, which can prevent monitoring tools, search engines, or real visitors from reliably reaching the page during busy periods.
recommendation: Your site is turning away visitors for asking too often. Ask your web team to give good bots more room. Good bots already crawl slowly. See ScanGovBot for what to allow.
recommendationTechnical: Review and relax rate-limiting thresholds for legitimate traffic, including known crawlers, or allowlist the scanning/monitoring service's IP (44.236.34.143 for ScanGovBot).

label: Internal Server Error
description: The server encountered an unexpected error and could not complete the request.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: An unhandled error on the server prevented the page from loading at all, affecting every visitor who requests this URL.
recommendation: Something broke on your site. Ask your web team to check the error logs and fix it.
recommendationTechnical: Check server error logs for the underlying exception and fix the code or configuration issue causing the crash.

label: Bad Gateway
description: The server received an invalid response from another server while processing the request.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: A server acting as a proxy or gateway got an invalid response from an upstream server, so the page failed to load — often a sign of backend or infrastructure trouble.
recommendation: One of the systems behind your site isn't responding. Ask your web team or hosting provider to check it.
recommendationTechnical: Check the health of upstream/backend servers and the configuration of the proxy or load balancer sitting in front of them.

label: Service Unavailable
description: The server is temporarily unable to handle the request, often due to maintenance or overload.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: The server can't currently handle the request, often due to maintenance or overload, so the page is temporarily unreachable.
recommendation: Your site is down or too busy to answer. If this is planned maintenance, it should clear up on its own. If not, ask your hosting provider to look into it.
recommendationTechnical: If this is planned maintenance, confirm it's temporary and communicated to users. If it's overload, investigate server capacity and traffic spikes.

label: Crawl-delay too long
description: A non-standard code ScanGov uses when a site's robots.txt asks crawlers to wait longer between requests than ScanGov will (30 seconds). The site itself loaded normally.
statusDescription: We didn't scan your site because its robots.txt asks crawlers to wait longer than we can.
problem: Your robots.txt sets a Crawl-delay above 30 seconds. ScanGov honours crawl-delay, and at that pace a scan can't finish, so the site is skipped and its content can't be verified here.
recommendation: Ask whoever manages your robots.txt to lower the crawl-delay for good bots, or to leave it out for ScanGovBot. See ScanGovBot for what to allow.
recommendationTechnical: Set "Crawl-delay: 30" or lower in the robots.txt group that applies to ScanGovBot, or add a "User-agent: ScanGovBot" group with no Crawl-delay directive. Rules in a specific ScanGovBot group take precedence over "User-agent: *".

label: Blocked by robots.txt
description: A non-standard code ScanGov uses when a site's robots.txt asks ScanGovBot not to crawl it. The site itself loaded normally.
statusDescription: We didn't scan your site because its robots.txt asked us not to.
problem: Your robots.txt disallows ScanGovBot (or all crawlers). ScanGov honours that request and does not scan the site, so its content can't be verified or shown here until the file allows the bot.
recommendation: If you want ScanGov to check your site, ask whoever manages your robots.txt to allow good bots. See ScanGovBot for what to allow.
recommendationTechnical: Add a group to /robots.txt that allows ScanGovBot: "User-agent: ScanGovBot" followed by "Allow: /". A blanket "User-agent: *" / "Disallow: /" rule blocks ScanGovBot unless a more specific ScanGovBot group allows it.

label: Request Denied
description: A non-standard code used by some sites to actively block automated or bot traffic.
statusDescription: We weren't able to fully scan your site.
problem: The site is actively blocking automated tools, including this scanner, so its content can't be verified or indexed by anyone using similar tools.
recommendation: Your site is blocking automated visitors on purpose, and that includes good bots. Ask whoever set that up to let good bots through. See ScanGovBot for what to allow.
recommendationTechnical: Review bot-blocking rules to allow legitimate crawlers and monitoring services, or confirm this restriction on this URL is intentional. Allow the ScanGovBot user-agent, or allowlist 44.236.34.143.
